skill.summary: Search documents, read document text, create docs from text or Markdown, and update document content and structure — powered by ClawLink.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release enabling Google Docs access via ClawLink integration:

- Search, read, export, and create Google Docs through a chat interface
- Update document content and structure with confirmation
- Guided setup using ClawLink for easy connection—no manual API configuration needed
- Dynamic discovery and execution of Google Docs tools based on user account and permissions
- Built-in confirmation steps for actions that modify or create documents
